reviews.title: DO NOT USE CASH REGISTRY!
reviews.text: I have been trying to get ahold of support for over a week and they are extremely difficult. The phone number rarely rings; I had to *67 to get my call to go through. Have sent multiple emails with no help.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I made my account, did my ENTIRE guest list and now I got signed out and can no longer access my account no matter how many times I try. Insanely disappointing after doing my guest list and registry.

reviews.title: App Buggy, and Support Unhelpful.
reviews.text: The app will not allow me to search for a couple; it comes up with an error message and tells me to contact support. I’ve been back and forth with support for days, and they have been unable to even understand my problem, let alone solve it. They finally just told me to ask someone else in the wedding party for the information on the website. Only use this app if you’re okay with your guests getting information through word of mouth rather than the website you spent time making.

reviews.title: Fund Access
reviews.text:
It takes entirely too long to transfer funds to a bank account! First, you have to wait 5–10 days for the money to become available for transfer. Then, the actual transfer takes additional time, meaning the entire process can take up to 15 days. That is absolutely ridiculous!

What makes this even more frustrating is that the platform already charges fees. Why should customers have to wait so long to access their own money? In an age when electronic transfers can happen almost instantly, there is no reasonable explanation for such a lengthy process. The entire system is unnecessarily slow, inconvenient, and frustrating. This process needs to be significantly improved!

reviews.title: Stop
reviews.text: Stop asking me to review your app

reviews.title: Money transfer
reviews.text: Transfers take days to post and even longer to transfer into your account

reviews.title: DO NOT CHOOSE CASH FUND!!!
reviews.text: They hold your money and do not gather all required info up front and come back to you days after you request your cash and ask for ID and such. Pathetic.

reviews.title: They stole our money and gifts!
reviews.text: Can’t get our cash gifts. Terrible customer service and should have never used them.

reviews.title: Lame products, confusing
reviews.text: 2 years into marriage, everything from Zola turned out to be junky. I don’t recommend it for you registry.

reviews.title: Great for planning, horrible for guest interaction
reviews.text:
This has been extremely stressful to use in the final weeks leading up to my wedding. 

It worked great for beginning plans and setting things up but as soon as I needed guests to start sending info it has been a battle to get anything in. 

I’m sure it works if you use their stationary but it costs way more then doing it yourself and isn’t worth it since I designed a much better looking one with my mom. 

If I could do all the planning again I would use a different platform. This has added way more stress than I thought it would despite advertising simple contact collection and RSVP. 

The planning tools were helpful and since I’m down to the wire on time I’m gonna have to stick it out. But I do wish I hadn’t used Zola.

reviews.title: DO NOT RECEIVE YOUR FUNDS OR GIFTS ON ZOLA!!!!!!
reviews.text: Zola is great for your rsvps and guest lists but don’t get funds sent your to registry!!! We set up a honeymoon fund and guests donated $350 that we now can’t access for 4 business days!!! Our honeymoon is literally only 4 days!!!!! So, you mean to tell me that the fund that Zola provides for your honeymoon cannot be actually used for your honeymoon!!!!???? That’s absolutely ridiculous! Now we don’t have our money and can’t enjoy the things we wanted to! Not to mention the gifts that people bought through there were never sent to me. The apron was bought in July and I still don’t have it. The crock pot was bought by a friend and completely disappeared from the gift tracker. It’s like it didn’t exist! Zola is a scam!!! Do NOT use it! It’s actually sick that you would do that and not have some kind of warning or tell us this information before having our guests donate money for something that can’t even be accessed when needed!!!!

reviews.title: Time frame
reviews.text: It already took 3-4 days pending and processing and then take up to 10 days to transfer to account. Should be faster a inconvenience to say the least

reviews.title: Do NOT use their registry
reviews.text: Zolas website is fine and RSVP, guest list tracker, etc are all good but oh my gosh DO NOT use their registry. Infuriating and it is NOT user friendly for guests. I’m so dissatisfied with it and sad that i didn’t realize sooner.

reviews.title: Seating Chart
reviews.text: Could only seat 15 guests on the seating chart. Was the only real benefit of the app vs the website and they make you pay to seat more than 15 guests. Was not advertised as such.

reviews.title: Missing addresses
reviews.text: They only printed addresses for about 30% of my guests and the rest are blank so we have to hand write them and have them look terrible.

reviews.title: Regret
reviews.text: Zola made us wait for the funds to process in the cash fund then another ten days for it to become available. Don't use Zola

reviews.title: Not Ideal
reviews.text: Much better products exist that do not push political beliefs on you, would recommend those.

reviews.title: Premium just to use seating chart?
reviews.text: Pay to add use the seating chart feature? Are you kidding? Just use a pen and paper, don’t waste your time or money.

reviews.title: Linking registry
reviews.text: Will not let me link Target registry. Says it’s linked but it is not.

reviews.title: Help me out!
reviews.text: My fiance isn’t able to use this app on android. Total bummer!

reviews.title: Doesn’t work!
reviews.text: The moment the updates occurred app stopped working!

reviews.title: Unreliable
reviews.text: I ordered stationary samples for wedding invitations 2 times. They took forever to arrive and the shipping tracking was never accurate. When it finally arrived, the paper was beautiful but this is too important to take chances on. The customer service team is a joke. They are unhelpful at best. While placing my wedding, I used other websites at the same time and Zola was the worst. The features and organization are lacking. Try something else.

reviews.title: Find Another Planner - do not go here!
reviews.text: This has been absolute torture using Zola.  Where to start? All their “help” is about registry and vendors, their focus is not helping you keep track of guests or preparing invitations.  For the invitations, I could not change the fonts for the envelopes, could not find where to edit a typo at the top of the website (it wasn’t in heading or banner) but in settings. Trying to enter meal options for RSVP replies requires going into two different pages,  and there is no welcome to the RSVP page when guests find your website. Then you have the issue of adding guests. So I downloaded their template, adjusted the column widths so I could read what I was typing, saved the excel file in their requested format and tried to upload my list - but it failed! Time and again, it would not load! So I manually entered the names and details of all my guests. When I went to review the pre addressed envelopes to send the invitations, they were a disaster and those had to be manually corrected. If I was not so far down the line, I would scrap Zola and find another provider. I am praying my guests can rsvp and that Zola can give me accurate headcounts, names and menu choices. I did not need a registry, partners or other things they try to sell you. Trying to work with my partner, we cannot work individually because they want to send an email confirmation to the main party to let you into your own account. So when he is 3 hours away in a different time zone, I can’t get into our wedding because the

reviews.title: I’m so frustrated
reviews.text:
I have been emailing Zola for days because after having issues for the past year planning my wedding, now I can’t even properly use the guest messaging feature I’ve paid for.i can’t even press recipients without an error coming up. When they responded, it was AI because twice I explained the situation and they said: what message did you send and to who in a whole thing. I told them I can’t even pick a person to send a message to..

I honestly don’t know if half my reminder messages went to everyone during the past year and some people would know about things and some wouldn’t.

ALSO they definitely bought ratings recently because I saw it last week and it was 2 or 3 stars.. should have screenshotted.

One last thing because I’m so annoyed.. they don’t have a call number and are hiding behind the AI answering their emails.

reviews.title: SUPPORT NEEDED
reviews.text: The app has been randomly kicking me out. I can no longer use the app to login. It just says contact support from more help but I’ve contacted you, but I’ve heard nothing from anyone. I can’t login anymore. My website is now down. All the pictures I uploaded are gone. Your registry is live, but I’m not using your registry. Everything has been sabotage. I am less than 90 days out for my wedding and I really need access to this because I put everything on your site without this, I am literally dead in the water. I need someone to respond.

reviews.title: Bug
reviews.text: App isn’t working, kept saying something went wrong

reviews.title: Seating chart is a scam
reviews.text: That app has been fine but getting to the seating chart: It let me add all the tables I wanted and arranged them. Then, once I started adding guests, I got the option to “upgrade to premium to seat more than 15 guests”. Suck my dick Zola ✌🏼

reviews.title: Absolutely terrible
reviews.text: This app makes every single task extremely difficult to manage. It is very difficult to edit anything, the registry items from Zola are all marked up at least %15 retail, transferring funds takes minimum 7 business days, it is hard for people to manage their RSVP’s and navigate the website. You’d be better off making a google form for guest list information and making an Amazon registry. Absolutely terrible

reviews.title: Not Entirely FREE. For Real.
reviews.text:
“You have enough quotes and bills to handle for your wedding, so we made Zola entirely FREE. For real.” -Zola

Claiming the app is entirely free and then charging to make a seating chart is wild

reviews.title: Problems with verification to withdraw funds
reviews.text: I want to withdraw money from Zola but no matter what documentation I provide it keeps not withdrawing. It’s been 2 months.

reviews.title: check your RSVP’s
reviews.text:
Double and triple check your rsvps against your guest list. Several people weren’t on the list to rsvp and were unable to even though they were on our guest list.

Oh and your packages might end up at your closest ups drop off/pick up points instead of your home, we received them at CVS after they called me to tell me I had nine packages there that were going to be sent back unless I pick them up that day because they had been there for so long

reviews.title: Withdrawing Money
reviews.text: We have now tried to withdraw our honeymoon funds no less than a dozen times and uploaded multiple pictures of our IDs with no luck. Great to not have access to your honeymoon funds on your honeymoon!!!

reviews.title: Wouldn’t recommend
reviews.text: Overly complicated, lots of surprise payments, can use a lot of my guests.

reviews.title: Login Issues
reviews.text: Every time I try to login to Zola to work on my wedding website. The app doesn’t let me in and says I need to contact support. Then when I try to I get nothing back or have to go through different channels to try and reach someone to help. Fix the login in problems this has been going on way before I complained about it.

reviews.title: Slow service
reviews.text: Very slow customer service. Takes over a week to hear back about crucial wedding details. Would not recommend based on their customer service.

reviews.title: Cash gifts - Waist of time!
reviews.text: Cash gifts on this app are worthless. Takes 10 days to get it transferred to a bank account. But it first takes a week for it to become available for transfer. Had cash donations from wedding and could not use any of it on the honey moon. Use Venmo!

reviews.title: Poorly Designed
reviews.text: Thought it would be nice to use the seating chart planner since we were using Zola to mange our guest list and registry. I download the app on the iPad and was hit with nothing but frustrations. The app WILL NOT rotate in order to change orientations. Then, I spend the time making the floor plan and putting down the table layout, and adding guests to the tables (btw, the keyboard hides the “save” button when you go to add guests, and if you miss this and click out, all of the guests you added will disappear). Once I’ve made the floor plan and added guests for just 3 tables, I am then prompted that I must pay to add more guests. No where does it warn me of this paywall before putting in the time to make the floor plan and add the first 15 guests to tables. Atrocious business practice.

reviews.title: Bad customer service and sms maintenance
reviews.text: Yesterday we sent out our wedding save the dates along with our website which was obviously very time consuming. When we went to send the save the dates by text 74 out of 111 texts did not go through. Apparently Zola was doing maintenance on their sms service and they did not alert anyone. This lead to a lot of stress and guest questions. We had to manually click on each name that it didn’t send to, the not delivered list was not in alphabetically order so I had to continuously scroll up and down to check off names and then was finally able to get the rest of the save the dates out. We called customer service yesterday at 6pm eastern and got an answering machine because it was apparently out of business hours. Ridiculous for a wedding service. We emailed yesterday and didn’t get a response until noon today. We called customer service again this morning and talked to Ken who told us nothing about the maintenance and said there’s nothing they can do on their end. We could only manually resend. They have no way of resending for us. Overall just created a lot of unnecessary stress and their customer service team is no help. I used Google Gemini to help me resolve the issue. Brides and grooms beware

reviews.title: UI / UX sucks
reviews.text: UI/UX design for guest’s RVSP process sucks, requires constant troubleshooting/adjustment from us, and my husband even works in IT . My husband and I had the first and only fight during the wedding planning process because of this stupid app/website. If it wasn’t for the fact that the website is already made ( I spent many hours on ), we’d ditch Zola and find an alternative.

reviews.title: Not user friendly
reviews.text: We downloaded the app and tried to log in with the wrong email onc.  It now won’t let us change the login email in the app even though we loaded all our information under a different email.  It wants us to start a new profile.  Un-installing and reinstalling the app doesn’t change anything.  This has rendered the app completely usesless for us on our iPad.   The real bummer is that we have been using the web browser up until this point but the seating chart feature doesn’t work in the web browser for us and it has left us in a frustrating dead end from the iOS app requirement.

reviews.title: Just let me type
reviews.text: App assumes the email you want to use and doesn’t give you an option to change it….

reviews.title: Don’t rely on Zola
reviews.text: The login process is broken, meaning that all data added into Zola is inaccessible. This app is fine as a toy to help occasionally with your wedding planning. But don’t get accustomed to it or rely it; it won’t be there when you need it

reviews.title: Immediately tries to sell you premium
reviews.text:
I downloaded this for the new seating chart function which I was so excited to try, loved that it could connect to the guest list I have and everything.

BUT. After only adding around 10 people, it stopped me from adding anymore and gave me the pop up of ‘add unlimited guests with premium’… seriously? 
Me using your site for my wedding and purchasing paper etc wasn’t enough? 
Sincerely, **** you. 
Waste of my time getting everything all laid out, enjoying the app, only to be locked out when finally plugging all the names in.

I was really enjoying using Zola for everything but this ticked me off so bad I will make it my duty to steer anyone I know getting married from using them. Fire whichever Einstein executive made this decision.
